title: Resolved
description: The resolved form: what `explain --json` prints, and what its human form is rendered from.

policy.description: The policy document the boundary was resolved from.

selection.description: How the profile was selected: each step up to the one that selected.

exclusions.description:
Subtracted from `paths`: these classes are denied at and beneath each path. Stated here,
to the operator, and never inward ([spec §8.4]).

[spec §8.4]: https://github.com/firefly-engineering/playpen/blob/main/docs/spec.md#84-exclusions

mach_services.description: macOS Mach services the child may look up; every other service is denied.

env.description:
The constructed environment, by name ([spec §9.3]): outward only, since the agent can read
its own `environ`.

[spec §9.3]: https://github.com/firefly-engineering/playpen/blob/main/docs/spec.md#93-inward-and-outward

Step.description: One step of the chain, and what came of it.

oneOf.description:
The step had no input: no `--profile`, no `PLAYPEN_PROFILE`, or no prefix containing the
working directory.
The step chose `profile`; for the CWD step, by the prefix that matched.
The step had an input and it refused: the refusal's code.

Access.description: What a grant allows. Execution follows readability: every readable path is executable.

Scope.description: How much of the filesystem a path grant covers.

oneOf.description: The path and, for a directory, everything beneath it.
The path itself and nothing beneath it.

Class.description:
An access class an exclusion subtracts ([spec §8.4]).

[spec §8.4]: https://github.com/firefly-engineering/playpen/blob/main/docs/spec.md#84-exclusions

NetworkMode.description:
playpen confines no network traffic ([spec §6.1]): the one mode there is.

[spec §6.1]: https://github.com/firefly-engineering/playpen/blob/main/docs/spec.md#61-what-is-not-confined

ResolvedVar.description: One variable of the constructed environment.

value.description:
What playpen or the policy wrote, shown lossily where it is not UTF-8. `null` for a name
passed through from the host, whose value playpen never inspects, and so never states.
